protocol.note: E133's blocks (E111's), run by run_e144b.py over E133's chain (run_kspeed.py over E64's run_hpl.py, E111's idle-login rule): REST holds no launch; nothing is set on the card; the residency read run_hpl.py makes after every run is not sent; the holds are Q138(t)'s frozen 15 minutes

safety.note: Q138(t)'s frozen aifoundry2 stops (predictions-e144.json rules.stops.aifoundry2, c2f9920d): the hold ends at a die reading >= 72 C or a board reading > 93 W on 3 samples (E133's 80 C / 93 W with the die tightened). run_hpl.py's watcher reads every live sampler line and applies 72 C to the die mean and to the hottest sensor. E111's and E133's H-F32 peaked at 88.04 and 88.65 W (none over 90 W) and a 67-68 C die mean; the hottest sensor's carried running maximum read 69-70 C
